author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Scientists have developed the Microscale Optoelectronic Tetherless Electrode (MOTE), the world's smallest wireless brain implant that records neural activity without batteries or wires. This ultra-miniaturized device uses optoelectronics and light-based communication to stream brain signals continuously for over a year, reducing tissue stress compared to traditional implants.

Source Article: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41928-025-01484-1
